tldr: Lilith in Taurus: the wound around security and worth; shame soothed by owning and consuming.
body: With Lilith in Taurus, old scarcity runs the show. Comfort, money, and possessions become survival itself: holding tight to what is owned, taking in more than is given out, and measuring safety in what can be kept.
gift: Groundedness, tenacity, and a real talent for building material security.
challenge: Greed and entitlement, doing almost anything for financial safety, attachment to possessions standing in for self-worth.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
